title: Antibiotic course collapsed gut microbiome alpha-diversity within 5 days
body:
Personal experiment: 16S sequencing of stool samples around a 7-day amoxicillin course.
[Step] Sampling
  [Input] daily home stool sample, [Tool] Zymo DNA/RNA Shield kit
[Step] Sequencing
  [Tool] external 16S V3–V4 service, [Output] Shannon index 3.4 → 1.9 by day 5
[Step] Recovery
  [Output] Shannon partially recovered to 2.8 by day 28, not back to baseline
N = 1 so this is not generalisable, but the direction matches the published literature on broad-spectrum antibiotic effects. Whether full recovery requires months or never reaches baseline depends on diet and the specific antibiotic — out of scope for this single experiment.
